style: Hand painted comic art: bold black ink outlines over saturated painted colour, magenta, orange and violet skies, deep violet and teal space, glowing mint green light, visible brush and pencil texture. Keep the painted comic look; do not make it photographic.

grade.note: Paul: a bespoke grade per comic, as many colours as the art needs, matched to the page

note: Crops cut clear of the lettering by tools/cut_crops.py. Regions read off a 1000 wide grid over the page (crop_px is page pixels). Provisional until the storyboard.

elements.title: Lyra in ruins
elements.prompt: A ruined alien city on a dead planet: toppled angular towers and broken buildings burning in red and orange, piles of white skulls in the foreground, a huge cratered pink moon in a magenta sky, smoke and dust rising, a small spaceship streaking away into the sky.

elements.title: The vessel QNTM CNTRL
elements.prompt: A long segmented green spaceship with glowing mint green engines flying through deep violet space, a bright white vapour trail curling behind it, a ringed pink planet and small moons below, scattered stars.

elements.title: The cryptid in the cockpit
elements.prompt: A big eyed alien creature with antennae, blue green skin and huge orange eyes sits in a cramped spaceship cockpit, hands on the controls, a pink window behind, bundles of cables and a giant DNA helix structure curving through the violet machinery beside it.

elements.title: The four-dimensional manifold
elements.prompt: Space folded into giant angled slabs like a zig zag of tall panels, each slab a window onto a different starfield and nebula in blue, green and violet, small planets between them, a glowing green spaceship passing through the folds with a white light trail.

elements.title: The crash site
elements.prompt: A crashed green spaceship half buried in a dark forest clearing at dusk, smoke rising from it, glowing lights in its hull, a line of tribal warriors with spears silhouetted on a ridge, pine trees against a pink and purple sky.

elements.title: The elder and the pod
elements.prompt: An old hooded tribal elder with a lined face leans over a glass hypersleep pod in which a sleeping blue skinned alien lies, the pod's green control panel marked with alien glyphs, other tribespeople watching behind in dim violet light.

elements.title: The bonfire ritual
elements.prompt: Inside a large tent of hanging red and purple cloth at night, a big campfire with tall orange flames and pale smoke rising to the roof, warm firelight glowing on the cloth walls, deep red and blue shadows.
elements.note: Refused twice by World Labs' content filter (HTTP 403, 'Violence', 25 October): first the wide crop with the sleeping alien beside the fire, then the reworded prompt. Recut to the tent, the smoke and the top of the fire, clear of the guards' spears and the dancers in the flames; the dancers come back as the bonfire film and the drum.

elements.title: The decode
elements.prompt: A giant glowing orange alien eye with flames reflected in its pupil, a bright mint green DNA double helix twisting across tall vertical panels of orange fire and warm light.

elements.title: The decode (no helix)
elements.prompt: A giant glowing orange alien eye with a black vertical slit pupil and blue skin around it, beside tall vertical panels of orange and pale yellow firelight with black ink outlines and white gaps between them.
elements.note: Paul, 25 October: remove the painted helix so the 3D one stands alone. The decode crop with the helix painted out by Nano Banana (films/sources.json stills o1-decode-clean-b, chosen over take a, which kept a sliver of helix in the pupil); crop_px is the original crop's, for its place on the page.
